mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_no, u.user_name, u.phone, u.dept_name, u.register_time, u.account_status, CASE u.account_status WHEN 0 THEN 'disabled' WHEN 1 THEN 'normal' END AS account_status_text, u.role_id, r.role_name FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_role r ON u.role_id = r.role_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, user_no, user_name, phone, dept_name, register_time, account_status, role_id FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user ( user_no, user_name, phone, dept_name, account_status, role_id ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{userName}, #{phone}, #{deptName}, #{accountStatus}, #{roleId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET user_no = #{userNo}, user_name = #{userName}, phone = #{phone}, dept_name = #{deptName}, account_status = #{accountStatus}, role_id = #{roleId} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
